source: Units. This handbook uses KiB, MiB, and GiB when a calculation explicitly uses binary powers of two. Product specifications are reproduced using the units printed by the vendor, such as GB and TB/s, rather than silently converting the labels.[2]
zh: 单位。当计算明确使用 2 的二进制幂时，本手册使用 KiB、MiB 和 GiB。产品规格使用供应商打印的单位（例如 GB 和 TB/s）复制，而不是默默地转换标签。 [2]
